📺 She-Hulk: Attorney at Law (2022)

She-Hulk: Attorney at Law follows Jennifer Walters, a talented lawyer whose life takes an extraordinary turn after an accident involving her cousin Bruce Banner, better known as the Hulk, causes her to develop incredible superhuman abilities. Suddenly capable of transforming into a powerful green superhero, Jennifer must learn to balance her demanding legal career with the unexpected challenges of being She-Hulk. Unlike Bruce, she wants to maintain a normal life, focusing on her career, friendships, dating experiences, and personal independence rather than becoming a full-time superhero. However, her new abilities attract public attention, complicated legal cases, dangerous enemies, and unexpected encounters with other powerful individuals. As Jennifer begins working in a special division handling cases involving superhumans, she faces hilarious courtroom situations, personal struggles, and surprising adventures. Combining superhero action, clever comedy, and fourth-wall-breaking storytelling, the series explores identity, confidence, relationships, workplace challenges, and the importance of defining success on your own terms.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Comedy • Superhero

⭐ IMDb: 5.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~30–38 minutes per episode • 1 season • 9 episodes

🎥 Creator: Jessica Gao

🏆 Recognition: Starring Tatiana Maslany, Mark Ruffalo, Tim Roth, Ginger Gonzaga, and Jameela Jamil, the series introduced Jennifer Walters as a leading character in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Known for its comedic approach, courtroom storylines, celebrity appearances, and unconventional superhero storytelling, it received attention for blending legal comedy with Marvel’s established superhero universe.

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+ in the United States and other supported regions.

source_details.synopsis: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law is an American television miniseries created by Jessica Gao for the streaming service Disney+, based on Marvel Comics featuring the character She-Hulk. It is the eighth television series in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) produced by Marvel Studios, sharing continuity with the films of the franchise. It follows Jennifer Walters, a lawyer specializing in cases involving superhumans, who is also the green superhero She-Hulk. Gao served as head writer and Kat Coiro led the directing team. Tatiana Maslany stars as Jennifer Walters / She-Hulk alongside Jameela Jamil, Ginger Gonzaga, Mark Ruffalo, Josh Segarra, Mark Linn-Baker, Tess Malis Kincaid, Tim Roth, Megan Thee
